blocks.html:
1. Home
  2. Tools
  3. Project estimator
Answer a few questions and build your brief: what you need, how big the job looks (S, M or L) and why, and what we need from you. Only the service is required, the rest is optional.
It is a brief, not a quote. Nobody is promising you a price or a delivery date here.
And your answers stay put, in your browser. They are not sent anywhere.
This tool needs JavaScript to run. You can still read the page without it. For an estimate, just use the contact page.
How we work out your band

headers: Total score for website building and UI/UX design
Total score for business model, documentation, marketing and content

items: If a question does not apply to your service, or you skip it, it scores 0 and shows up in your brief as "Not answered".
A fixed date does not push your band up. It goes in the brief under risks instead.
Wanting a penetration test next to another service does not change the band either. Penetration testing always gets its own proposal, with a fixed scope.
A band is just the rough size of the work. Not a price, not a timeline. A fixed price only exists after we talk it through and put it in a written proposal.
